name: Vault Bali
description: is an underground nightclub located in the Berawa/Canggu area of Bali, known for its exclusive atmosphere, top-tier sound system, and a mix of music genres like Hip-Hop, R&B, and electronic music. It features a hidden entrance, a bunker-style design, and regularly hosts Bali’s top DJs and international guests.
note:
Party every Monday, Wednesday, Thursday, Friday & Saturday
Each night brings a different music vibe
Free entry when you mention Guestlist Canggupedia at the entrance
(before midnight, or 11:30PM on Saturdays)
Stay tuned to our daily Instagram stories for event details
priceRange: Rp 150.000 – Rp 300.000 entry + standard drinks; VIP table/minimum spend significantly higher
